mapper.select: SELECT V.VACNTN_ICTSD , VR.VACNTN_INOCL_DT , VR.CHLDRN_NO , V.VACNTN_CNT , V.VACNTN_ERA , VR.VACNTN_REMNDR , V.VACNTN_ODR , ( SELECT VM.MTH_NM FROM vacntn_mth VM WHERE VM.VACNTN_MTH_NO = V.VACNTN_MTH_NO ) AS mthNm FROM vacntn_rcord VR LEFT OUTER JOIN vacntn V ON V.VACNTN_NO = VR.VACNTN_NO WHERE V.VACNTN_ICTSD = #{vacntnIctsd} AND VR.CHLDRN_NO = #{chldrnNo}

SELECT VM.MTH_NM , V.VACNTN_ICTSD , MAX(V.VACNTN_ODR) AS vacntnOdr , MAX(V.VACNTN_NO) AS vacntnNo , MAX(VR.CRT_DT) AS vacntnRcordCrtDt FROM vacntn_rcord VR LEFT OUTER JOIN vacntn V ON V.VACNTN_NO = VR.VACNTN_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN vacntn_mth VM ON VM.VACNTN_MTH_NO = V.VACNTN_MTH_NO WHERE VR.CHLDRN_NO = #{chldrnNo} GROUP BY VM.MTH_NM, V.VACNTN_ICTSD
